aggressive_tail.description: Compatibility profile for the old TOML aggressive_tail strategy; runs base_no_ev with looser threshold and smaller size.

base_no_ev.description: Current calibrated exact-bucket NO EV strategy.

base_yes_no_ev.description: Exact-bucket strategy that evaluates both YES and NO.

ensemble_bucket_ev.description: Averages GFS/ECMWF bucket probabilities when both are available.

dynamic_sigma_ev.description: Widens uncertainty by lead time and model disagreement.

bayesian_climatology_ev.description: Blends model probability with historical settlement climatology.

corridor_ladder.description: Buys adjacent bucket corridors when summed probability beats summed cost.

nowcast_metar.description: Reprices same-day buckets with METAR current max observations.

threshold_union.description: Synthesizes threshold/tail markets from bucket ladders.

monthly_remainder.description: Placeholder for monthly precipitation/snow remainder pricing.

basket_arb.description: Scans full bucket ladders for buy-every-bucket arbitrage.

maker_quote_sim.description: Simulates passive NO quote improvement and maker-fee advantage.
